column3: The True Little Sister Showdown : Siscalypse
...What did you just say?
Nothing, really...
Hey, you. Do you understand the position that you're in right now?
My position?
I'll tell you once more since you don't seem to get it.
All you need to do is listen to whatever I say. Are you all right?
Yes, understand!
Thought I'd say that?!
Your pronunciation sucks, it's on a dropout's level.
Dropout is a taboo word for someone taking his exams this year!
Hah...
This discussion is a waste of time.
U-urgh... You...
What is it? Do you have anything you want to say?
Not really...
Ah, really? Lame...
I mean, thanks to me, you'll be able to join the tournament...
You could show some gratitude.
No, I don't remember saying that I would participate.
Eh? Even though I arranged this so friendless you could have social interactions.
I do! I definitely do have friends!
And stop with that "Lies, I'm super-shocked" face! Even my feelings can be hurt!
Furthermore, are there any benefits for me by participating in this tournament?
If you win, I will be happy. If your cute little sister is happy, you will be happy as well!
...You say some dreadful things sometimes.
W-What... are you saying?
Aren't you happy? To be together with such a cute girl! it's quite a rare chance.
Don't say that about yourself.
Anyway, you're going to join the Siscaly game tournament.
You will have to be able to win at least 30 consecutive rounds before the tournament. That's the norm.
30 consecutive rounds?! Impossible! Totaaally impossible!!
Why are you giving up before you've even started?
No matter what you say, impossible is impossible!
That's why! You have to practice!
Even if we are strong, you'll do more harm than good if you drag us down.
Excluding myself, out of the three others, you suck the most!
...I think it's impossible... Your request is simply too unrealistic...
Don't say that you can't do it.
By the way, I will be having my exams this year and I won't have time to do this, get it?
Then just make some time. Don't you want to play with me?
Besides, this is inevitable.
I-Inevitable?
It has been decided ever since you were born into this world!
Already decided?! Don't I have a right to object?!
Of course not.
That brat...
Anyway, I'm counting on you.
Well, that concludes this.
Hold it right there!
Tsk, what is it? Why don't you just cut it out?
Like - I - said...
If you were to drag us down, you'll be...
I'll be...?
...You know, don't you?
Death? Is it death?
It's already been decided by fate that you'll participate.
